easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Blur.
description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Blur, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Blur, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.
